I'll write the renderer using a `List[string]` plus a single join (never `+=`), an ordinal `SortedDictionary` for levels, and manual string concatenation in the hot loop.<tool_call>Write calls here>{\"reply\":null,\"calls\":[{\"name\":\"Write\",\"arguments\":{\"file_path\":\"briefkit.ps1\",\"content\":\"# briefkit.ps1 - shift-brief renderer\\n# Dot-source this file, then call:  Build-ShiftBrief -Path <logfile>\\n# Returns the whole brief as a single [string] (LF-joined, trailing LF).\\n#\\n# Perf note: the document is built into a List[string] and joined once at the\\n# end. Never grow the document with += inside the loop - string concatenation\\n# is O(n) per call and the whole build becomes O(n^2), which is what sank the\\n# old prototype on 500k-line logs.\\n\\nfunction Build-ShiftBrief {\\n    [CmdletBinding()]\\n    param(\\n        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]\\n        [string]$Path\\n    )\\n\\n    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Leaf)) {\\n        throw \\\"briefkit: log not found: $Path\\\"\\n    }\\n\\n    $lines = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllLines($Path)\\n\\n    $out = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new($lines.Length + 8)\\n    $null = $out.Add('shift brief')\\n\\n    # Ordinal comparer keeps case-sensitive levels distinct (WARN != warn)\\n    # and gives ordinal sorting for free.\\n    $levels = [System.Collections.Generic.SortedDictionary[string, int]]::new(\\n        [System.StringComparer]::Ordinal)\\n\\n    $idx = 0\\n    $skip = 0\\n    foreach ($ln in $lines) {\\n        if ($null -eq $ln -or $ln.Trim().Length -eq 0) { continue }\\n        $f = $ln.Split(' ')\\n        if ($f.Count -ne 5 -or\\n            $f[0].Length -eq 0 -or $f[1].Length -eq 0 -or $f[2].Length -eq 0 -or\\n            $f[3].Length -eq 0 -or $f[4].Length -eq 0) {\\n            $skip++\\n            continue\\n        }\\n        $idx++\\n        $lv = $f[2]\\n        if ($levels.ContainsKey($lv)) {\\n            $levels[$lv]++\\n        } else {\\n            $levels[$lv] = 1\\n        }\\n        if ($lv.Length -lt 5) { $lv = $lv.PadRight(5) }\\n        $null = $out.Add(($idx.ToString('D7') + ' ' + $lv + ' ' + $f[0] + '/' + $f[1] + ' ' + $f[3] + 'ms ' + $f[4]))\\n    }\\n\\n    $null = $out.Add(\\\"entries: $idx\\\")\\n    $null = $out.Add(\\\"skipped: $skip\\\")\\n    foreach ($k in $levels.Keys) {\\n        $null = $out.Add('level ' + $k + ': ' + $levels[$k])\\n    }\\n\\n    return ($out -join \\\"`n\\\") + \\\"`n\\\"\\n}\\n\"}}]}", "reasoning_chars": 2652}, "finish_reason": "stop"}], "usage": null, "streamed": true}
